name: ConstructConnect Project Intelligence
summary: A lead-finding database that searches active projects by trade, location and stage, with curated lead matching.
differentiator: This finds work instead of managing bids. ConstructConnect says it covers 825,000+ active projects across 382 metro areas, so a sub can find a project without waiting for an invitation, which BuildingConnected and PlanHub largely depend on. It pays off for a sub that bids public and commercial work all year, and it adds little for a firm whose work comes from three repeat GCs.
pricing: Third-party sources report Starter at $129 per month and Professional at $199 per month on annual or quarterly terms, with a Pro plus Takeoff tier on custom pricing. Not confirmed on the vendor page.
bestFor: Subs who need a steady supply of new public and commercial leads.
skipIf: Most of your work already comes from repeat GCs.
